notes.content: Students must select one of the following areas of study (6-7 units) for completion of the major course requirements: Lifecycle Nutrition Area of Study Media and Writing Area of Study Sports Nutrition Area of Study The Sports Nutrition Area of Study is not listed below, as it consists of upper division coursework only. See the University Catalog for the full listing of degree requirements.
notes.contentHtml:
Students must select one of the following areas of study (6-7 units) for completion of the major course requirements:

  • Lifecycle Nutrition Area of Study
  • Media and Writing Area of Study
  • Sports Nutrition Area of Study


The Sports Nutrition Area of Study is not listed below, as it consists of upper division coursework only. See the University Catalog for the full listing of degree requirements.
